# Parse the old songs list from the file content.
old_songs_content = old_songs_file["content"]
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("#") or not line:
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith("- "):
        line = line[2:]
    if " by " in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(",")]
        old_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})
    else:
        # Just title?
        old_songs.append({"title": line.strip(), "artists": []})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs:")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)
